evals.name: reinstall-select
evals.prompt: The select component is acting weird after we bumped the Spartan packages. Can you reinstall it fresh?
evals.expected_output: Deletes src/app/shared/components/spartan/select AND removes the @/shared/components/spartan/select tsconfig path alias (otherwise the CLI prints 'already installed' and skips), then runs `npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui select` from Homestead.WebApp/. Verifies the alias was re-added and runs healthcheck + build + tests + self-qa.

evals.name: bulk-regen-keeps-icon
evals.prompt: Regenerate all the Spartan helm components from the current CLI templates.
evals.expected_output: Loops one `npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui <name>` per component (utils first) rather than the interactive picker, strips the tsconfig aliases first, then restores the vendored `icon` helm via `git checkout HEAD -- Homestead.WebApp/src/app/shared/components/spartan/icon` and does NOT migrate `<ng-icon hlm size>` usages. Finishes with healthcheck, build, npm test, and the self-qa subagent.

evals.name: ng0309-after-regen
evals.prompt: After regenerating the alert-dialog helm, opening any confirm dialog throws NG0309 'matches multiple times'. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Identifies that hlmAlertDialogCancel/hlmAlertDialogAction now bring HlmButton via hostDirectives, so a button that also has hlmBtn double-applies BrnButton. Fix: remove the redundant hlmBtn and pass variant/size as inputs on the cancel/action directive.
